name: BTC vs ETH — 30-Day Realized Volatility
description: Research study comparing 30-day rolling realized volatility for BTC and ETH. Computes daily log returns, then rolling 30-day standard deviation annualized by sqrt(365) for crypto's 365-day trading calendar, expressed as a percentage. Outputs a time series line chart and a summary statistics table.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BTC vs ETH — 30-Day Realized Volatility
# =============================================================================
# Daily log returns → rolling 30-day stddev → annualize × sqrt(365) → percentage
# Crypto trades 365 days/year, so annualization uses sqrt(365)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- Daily log returns ---
log_ret = ln(close / (close >> 1))

# --- Rolling 30-day realized volatility (annualized, as %) ---
# stddev(30) gives rolling 30-day standard deviation of log returns
# Multiply by sqrt(365) to annualize, then × 100 for percentage
rv_30d = stddev(period=30)(log_ret) * sqrt(365) * 100

# --- Timestamp for X-axis ---
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# Chart 1: Rolling realized vol comparison over time
cs_lines(
    title='BTC vs ETH — 30-Day Realized Volatility',
    category='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Realized Volatility (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=rv_30d)

# Table: Summary statistics per asset
cs_summary_table(
    title='Realized Volatility Summary',
    category='Volatility',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Realized Volatility Summary',
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current RV (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, card_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg RV (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, card_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Max RV (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, card_agg=AggregationType.Max),
            ColumnSpec(title='Min RV (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, card_agg=AggregationType.Min)
        ],
        include_timestamp=False
    ),
    order=1
)(rv_30d, rv_30d, rv_30d, rv_30d)
